Material 3 Architecture

The four foundations of Material 3

Every token, surface and component follows Google's official design system specifications.

  • 3-tier design tokensOver 508 isolated properties across Reference, System, and Component token tiers.
  • Curated Unsplash photosHigh-resolution photography anchored with focal cropping and responsive WebP formats.
  • Local Roboto suiteRoboto Flex brand headlines, Roboto Plain body copy, Roboto Serif, and Roboto Mono.

FAQ

Questions, answered

What makes this Material Design 3 theme unique?

It implements the full Google Material Design 3 specification: 3-tier design tokens, 4 Roboto font families preloaded locally, 5 adaptive scaffold slots, and 36 official UI components.

How does the theme handle Unsplash imagery?

Images are processed through an edge media pipeline that calculates focal cropping, generates responsive AVIF and WebP formats, and applies optical corner radiuses.

Is the theme accessible for all users?

Yes. All text and background combinations pass WCAG 2.1 AA contrast audits (4.5:1 minimum), touch targets respect the 48×48dp rule, and full keyboard navigation is built in.

Do I need a database to run the theme?

No. Interstellar CMS is 100% Git-backed. All content and theme tokens are stored as plain files in your GitHub repository and deployed to Cloudflare Edge.
